question: What distinct posthumous attainments await dwellers of nāka versus dwellers of svarga?
premises: Those dwelling in nāka go to divam.
Those dwelling in svarga may obtain mokṣa.
Different celestial abodes correspond to different posthumous outcomes.
inference: Dwellers of nāka and dwellers of svarga are assigned distinct posthumous destinations.
uncertainties: The precise distinction between nāka, divam, and svarga in this context is not fully specified.
plain_english: Those who dwell in nāka go to heaven, while those who dwell in svarga may obtain liberation.
